title: Scheduled proof purge
body:
### Summary

As a quality architect, I want purge to run weekly in Actions, so that retention holds without anyone remembering it.

### Completion Goal

1. [api-trace] state: the purge workflow dispatched on a scratch repository with an expired recording; expected: the run tombstones it and succeeds

### Measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### Threshold

all 1 criteria

### Scenario

Dispatch the workflow on a scratch repository and read the ledger after it.

### Environment

local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production
